problem:
An object is projected vertically downward from a building with a velocity of $0.9\,\text{km/min}.$ It takes the object $4\,\text{s}$ to hit the ground. What is the height of the building? **Do not round your answer**.

*Hint: The acceleration due to gravity is $9.8\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}.$*

The height of the building is{{field-1}}$\text{m}.$
